draft_text: On identical hardware at batch size 16, Nimbrake delivers higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, at 142 versus 119 requests per second.
revised_text: On identical hardware, Nimbrake measured 142 requests per second versus Caskline's 119 on Driftbay-Serve; however, Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16, so the figures are not directly comparable.
rationale: The claim states "at batch size 16," but the table note says Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16, so the figures are not directly comparable. The numbers 142 vs 119 are correct, but the batch-size framing and comparability are misstated.
